name: alteraltar: a gentleman jack dilemma
source:
[i]if others will die because you lived, would you still choose to live?[/i]

part of the [url=https://hitman.drr.ac/]gentleman jack[/url] series about the unhealthy determination to live even if that means others will die because you did.

[From [url=https://swanchime.itch.io/alteraltar]Itch.io[/url]]
